findings.explanation: INV-1014 states a total of 246,000 INR with GST @ 18% and a tax line of 36,000 INR, but the implied subtotal of 210,000 INR would yield 37,800 INR of tax (or a 36,000 INR tax implies a 200,000 INR subtotal and 236,000 INR total), so the document's own subtotal, rate, and total do not reconcile.
